item.title: NEW / OLD SONDS OT TODAY!!BASS WOMB ROOM: My ‘9s 4-Track Dem...
item.description: NEW / OLD SONDS OT TODAY!!BASS WOMB ROOM: My ‘9s 4-Track Demos x Field Recordings is a 15-track album, mostly written and recorded by Melissa Auf der Maur on her trusted Tascam 4-Track tape recorder in her home living room studios in the 9s“These songs were the sound of my internal experimentation and a way of keeping the Montreal art girl alive inside while playing in a major label rock band. A raw, weird, time capsule!”The album was produced by Auf der Maur and @a_crow Alex Crow, and is the soundtrack to the BASS WOMB ROOM, a video art installation (a GIANT IMMERSIVE MIRROR PYRAMID!!!) in her first museum exhibition opening next week at @agotorontoReleased first on cassette out today on @envisionmanagement TODAY, worldwide distribution on Linktree“Meet Me in the BASS WOMB ROOM”

item.title: COMMNAL GRIEF x HEALINGTHE STRANDFri September 11, 6 is the 5th ...
item.description: COMMNAL GRIEF x HEALINGTHE STRANDFri September 11, 6 is the 5th anniversary of the day that changed NYC forever … I was in New York that day, and watched the burning towers from the roof of the Chelsea Hotel where I lived. I believe that communing together around meaningful creative connection is a special way to observe this day and ACTIVATE COLLECTIVE GRIEF AND HEALING… I am honored to be invited back to the Strand to launch my photo book, My 9s Rock Photographs, where I will be in conversation with Kelefa Sanneh, an amazing thinker and New Yorker. It promises to be a mindful conversation about where the arts, culture and this country have traversed in the last two decades, since the turn of the millennium, and that significant day in New York City and our shared history. Through kindness, clear eyed-ness, and gathering, we can grieve together, in hopes of collective healing.OXYTOCIN IN THE BOOK STORE! xMxRIP GLORIA, KSAMA & DOLLY

item.title: Former Hole bassist Melissa Auf der Maur’s new photography boo...
item.description: Former Hole bassist Melissa Auf der Maur’s new photography book, ‘My ’9s Rock Photographs,’ “intimately captures the chaos of the iconic era in music and American youth culture.” Through an exclusive selection of images, Auf der Maur takes @harpersbazaarus through her time with Courtney Love and the gang.⁠⁠@julia__silverberg writes: “Auf der Maur’s photos from that time are more than a personal trove; they capture the essence of a particular moment in ’9s music, a pre-iPhone era from which ephemera is more rarefied and during which having a female band photographer who was also in the band was basically unheard of. The images distill that raw grunge spirit: backstage mirror pics, partying starlets, and, of course, hundreds of hotel rooms all rendered in blurred-out yet vivid colors and candid compositions. Around of these images are now compiled in Auf der Maur’s new book, ‘My ’9s Rock Photographs,’ coming out September 8 in conjunction with an exhibition at @agotoronto.”⁠⁠Full review via linkinbio.⁠⁠Monograph co-published by @delmonico_books ⁠Edited with text by @hackettse & @jimshedden ⁠Foreword by stephanjostago ⁠Text by @xmadmx @annkpowers @fultonstreet @michaelstipe & Grace Elizabeth Hale⁠⁠#melissaaufdermaur #madm #my9srockphotographs⁠⁠
